newsitem.title: GERMANY: Linde names Gerhard Full as board chairman.
newsitem.headline: Linde names Gerhard Full as board chairman.

text.p: German engineering group Linde AG said on Wednesday that it had appointed Gerhard Full to take over as management board chairman from Hans Meinhardt from May of next year.

Full has been with Linde since 1962 and has been a member of the management board since 1978. He has worked in various sectors of the company including hydraulics and refrigeration technology, Linde said in a statement.
Since 1993, Linde has worked in the plant construction sector and has been in charge of coordinating technology and organisation, as well as personnel, for many years.
The changeover should take place at the group's annual meeting on May 13, 1997 and Meinhardt will be put forward for election to the chair of the group's supervisory board.
